topics.reason: Recorded official DSH→coding-agent progress vs unchanged DSH→Grok plugin gap from the earlier cross-dispatch source.
Added synthesis on DSH official plugins delegating to CC/Codex as sub-agents within the measurable isolation / fresh execution window bound.
Linked hands-on official sub-agent plugins to 0.2.1 experimental CC/Codex compatibility on the plugin-composed host path.
Added DSH-as-harness orchestrator dispatching CC/Codex workers alongside existing Grok foreman paths.
Article does not add a distinct subscription-value claim beyond prerequisites already covered under foreman layering.
Sub-agent dispatch inside DSH does not change the workflows-before-agents thesis about when to add open-ended agents.
